{"response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","candidates":[{"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nvoid restart_mab(kissat *solver) {\n\n    // Static variables to maintain algorithm state across restarts\n    // r_prev: Stores the previous raw reward for each mode\n    // consecutive_count: Tracks how many times the current mode has been chosen in a row\n    // last_ticks: Snapshot of solver-\u003eticks at the start of the phase\n    static double r_prev[2] = {0.0, 0.0};\n    static int consecutive_count = 0;\n    static uint64_t last_ticks = 0;\n\n    // Detect if this is a fresh solver instance or first run\n    // If both selection counts are 0, reset static state\n    if (solver-\u003emab_select[0] == 0 && solver-\u003emab_select[1] == 0) {\n        r_prev[0] = 0.0;\n        r_prev[1] = 0.0;\n        consecutive_count = 0;\n        last_ticks = 0; // Assume start of solving was tick 0\n    }\n\n    // Step 1: Compute the raw reward R\n    // R = log2(conflicts_generated + 1) / (elapsed_ticks + 1)\n    uint64_t current_ticks = solver-\u003eticks;\n    uint64_t elapsed_ticks = 0;\n    if (current_ticks \u003e last_ticks) {\n        elapsed_ticks = current_ticks - last_ticks;\n    }\n    \n    // Update last_ticks for the start of the next phase\n    last_ticks = current_ticks;\n\n    double conflicts = (double)solver-\u003emab_conflicts;\n    double R = 0.0;\n    // log2 is available in \u003cmath.h\u003e\n    if (elapsed_ticks + 1 \u003e 0) {\n        R = log2(conflicts + 1.0) / (double)(elapsed_ticks + 1.0);\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Calculate the performance trend T\n    // T = R - R_prev\n    unsigned mode = solver-\u003eheuristic;\n    // Ensure mode index is safe (expecting 0 or 1)\n    if (mode \u003e 1) mode = 0;\n\n    double T = R - r_prev[mode];\n    // Update R_prev to R for this mode\n    r_prev[mode] = R;\n\n    // Step 3: Update the Q-value (score)\n    // Q_new = 0.85 * Q_old + 0.15 * (R + 2.0 * T)\n    // We use solver-\u003emab_reward to store Q\n    double Q_old = solver-\u003emab_reward[mode];\n    double Q_new = 0.85 * Q_old + 0.15 * (R + 2.0 * T);\n    solver-\u003emab_reward[mode] = Q_new;\n\n    // Step 4: Calculate the Selection Score S for both modes\n    double S[2];\n    \n    // For the mode just finished: S = Q_new * (0.95 ^ consecutive_count)\n    S[mode] = Q_new * pow(0.95, consecutive_count);\n\n    // For the inactive mode: S = Q_current\n    unsigned other = 1 - mode;\n    S[other] = solver-\u003emab_reward[other];\n\n    // Step 5: Select the mode with the highest S\n    unsigned next_mode = mode;\n    if (S[other] \u003e S[mode]) {\n        next_mode = other;\n    } else {\n        next_mode = mode; // Tie-breaking: prefer current/stable\n    }\n\n    // Update consecutive_count based on selection\n    if (next_mode != mode) {\n        consecutive_count = 0;\n    } else {\n        consecutive_count++;\n    }\n\n    // Apply selection\n    solver-\u003eheuristic = next_mode;\n    solver-\u003emab_select[next_mode]++;\n\n    // Reset MAB tracking fields for the next phase (Standard Kissat cleanup)\n    solver-\u003emab_decisions = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_conflicts = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_chosen_tot = 0;\n    \n    for (all_variables(idx)) {\n        solver-\u003emab_chosen[idx] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP"}],"usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":1022,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5867}],"promptTokenCount":5867,"thoughtsTokenCount":8915,"totalTokenCount":15804},"responseId":"6IWPacmfPNOM_PUPhOHnsQI"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
